uniprot.function: Essential virulence factor involved in regulating host-pathogen interactions by regulating multiple host cell functions. Interacts with host TLR4 receptor at the macrophage cell surface and promotes activation of the canonical NF-kappa-B signaling pathway to stimulate secretion of the proinflammatory cytokines TNF, IL-12 and IL-6. Strongly induces apoptosis by inducing pro-apoptotic factors and efficiently activating the reticulum endoplasmic stress-mediated UPR pathway. Probably induces apoptosis of macrophages late in the infection cycle after excessive mycobacterial burden to aid in the apo
